name: ask-jev
description: Typed, low-latency decisions through the Jev System One API.

interface.shortDescription: Fast typed classification, scoring, and probability judgments
interface.longDescription: Use Jev's System One model for low-latency typed decisions over text and structured state: select from described choices, score on ordered scales, estimate proposition probabilities, and batch-classify many independent items.
defaultPrompt: Score this state on an ordered scale.
